# rcheevos

Unmodified include/ and src/ from RetroAchievements/rcheevos v12.5.0,
tag commit 1433173220a7eaede6a9ed7a18e94117be1821e0.

Source: https://github.com/RetroAchievements/rcheevos/tree/v12.5.0
